Format an enrollment data frame as a flextable

Source: R/01_trend_enrollment.R
plot_enrollment_table.Rd

Applies the package's standard flextable styling to an enrollment counts or proportions data frame. Suppressed cells are shown as "—" and rows with year-over-year proportion changes greater than 5 percentage points are highlighted in yellow.

Usage

plot_enrollment_table(
  counts_or_proportions,
  type = "counts",
  assessment_spec,
  shift_threshold = 5
)

Arguments

counts_or_proportions

A data frame — output of compute_enrollment_counts() or compute_enrollment_proportions().

type

Character scalar: "counts", "proportions", or "combined". Controls which highlight logic is applied. Default "counts".

assessment_spec

Named list describing the assessment program.

shift_threshold

Numeric. Absolute percentage-point change above which a row is highlighted. Applies only when pct_change is in the data. Default 5.

Value

A flextable object.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
source(system.file("specs/00_DEMO_Assessment_Spec.R", package = "ReportR"))
counts <- compute_enrollment_counts(demo_data, by = "YEAR", assessment_spec)
plot_enrollment_table(counts, assessment_spec = assessment_spec)
} # }
